verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a public REST API (versioned v0, with an official OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema), and its API reference includes an endpoint to list a project's issues and bulk-mutate them, which covers listing and updating issues. The pack does not show raw-event retrieval or scoped token permissions; the only token evidence is pasting one into sentry-cli login. missing for 10: documented endpoint for fetching raw events, evidence of scoped auth tokens, detail on issue query/search syntax, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
